title: escalation-huddle-scratch-priya
content:
Context:
- Customer: BrightCart (large retail customer, Dedicated cluster)
- Incident: periodic latency spikes on text-generation endpoint; observed timeouts at 95th+ pctl during peak hours (11:00-13:00 PST).
- Severity: currently P1 for BrightCart (high business impact) — CS escalated to eng/runtime.
- My role: run the initial huddle, capture notes, assign follow-ups, shepherd postmortem timeline.

Huddle goals (30-45m):
1) Confirm current state: is mitigation live? who executed it?
2) Short-term actions to stabilize customer traffic (workarounds + timeframe).
3) Triage ownership: who owns telemetry, model routing, infra scaling, customer comms.
4) Clear next steps and SLAs for action items (owners + due times).
5) Decide if escalation needs exec briefing + dedicated war-room channel.

Pre-reads / quick links to share at start:
- Incident timeline (WIP): link -> JIRA-INC-2048
- Recent deploys: PR #912 (serving-runtime) — potential kernel change at 2026-03-08 22:14 UTC
- BrightCart request traces: s3://redwood-observability/brightcart/traces/2026-03-10-11-00.json

Initial notes / observations (from logs + SRE ping):
- Spikes line up with cache invalidation windows (~11:02 UTC, daily job) — hypothesis A: cache churn + large batch of long-context requests.
- Some backend hosts report OOM-kill events 11:05-11:12 UTC (node autoscaler may not have spun up fast enough).
- A small fraction (~2%) of requests show increased sequence lengths (client-side change?) — need product contact to confirm.

Agenda items (minute-by-minute):
- 0:00–0:05 Quick intro, set scope (Priya)
- 0:05–0:12 Telemetry walk (Miguel) — top metrics, traces, errors
- 0:12–0:20 Infra findings (Samira) — autoscaler, OOMs, instance churn
- 0:20–0:28 Runtime/model angle (Chao) — kernel/regression, quantization mismatches
- 0:28–0:35 Customer comms & mitigation (Priya + CS rep)
- 0:35–0:45 Assignments, timelines, next check-in cadence

Immediate mitigation options (fast to implement):
- Option A: Short-term traffic shaping for BrightCart (rate limit heavy TL; reduce max sequence length server-side) — pros: immediate; cons: changes customer UX. Owner: Priya / CS. ETA: 20–30m to apply, monitor 15m.
- Option B: Spin additional dedicated nodes with higher mem profile and pin heavy models to them — Owner: Samira. ETA: 12–20m if capacity warm; if cold, 45–60m.
- Option C: Roll back PR #912 to previous kernel selection (if correlation holds) — Owner: Chao/eng-runtime. ETA: 30–60m including verification.

Questions to ask BrightCart on the call (need CS to confirm):
- Any recent client changes to prompt templates? increases in max_tokens or new long-context calls?
- Any observed client-side retries or bulk job windows at 11:00–13:00 local?
- Can they throttle non-critical traffic for next 2 hours?

Quick comms draft (to send after huddle):
Subject: BrightCart — immediate mitigation plan and next steps
Hi [BrightCart eng lead],
Thanks for your patience — summary from our triage session: we observed latency spikes correlated with daily cache invalidation at ~11:02 UTC and a subset of long-context requests. We are applying a short-term traffic-shaping rule and spinning additional higher-memory nodes. We expect visible improvement within 30–45 minutes and will update at T+30.
Action items (owner — due):
- Priya: push traffic-shape rule (reduce max seq to 1024 for non-critical route) — due 2026-03-13T11:30Z
- Samira: provision two high-mem nodes and pin model variants — due 2026-03-13T11:45Z
- Miguel: confirm traces for post-mitigation verification and produce summary (samples + p95/p99 comparison) — due 2026-03-13T12:00Z
- Chao: verify PR #912 regression hypothesis and prepare rollback if needed — due 2026-03-13T12:15Z
- CS (Lena Ortiz): confirm if BrightCart can throttle non-critical jobs for 2 hours — due 2026-03-13T11:20Z

Notes / heuristics to capture during huddle (things I must remember to ask):
- Does autoscaler have a cooldown preventing fast scale? check HPA metrics vs desired replicas.
- Any data-path changes (KVS/cache TTLs) in last 48h?
- Are there any recent model weight/quantization uploads for BrightCart's pinned version?

Post-meeting follow-up template (I will send after we confirm actions):
- Short summary of findings (2–3 bullets)
- Timeline of mitigations applied + visible effect metrics
- Action owners + deadlines (table)
- Ask: do we want a deeper RCA and a 72h postmortem? Recommended if incident > 30m of degraded p99.

Back-of-mind risks / escalation triggers I will watch for after huddle:
- If p99 does not improve by 30m after mitigation, escalate to exec on-call and open a dedicated Slack channel with customer leadership.
- If OOMs continue despite new nodes, we may need to roll forward a config that reduces batch size or revisits kernel selection.

Scratch log (to update during call):
- 11:04 Miguel: trace sample id t-4932 -> large seq, KV misses 73%
- 11:06 Samira: spun new node a-07, not ready (quota?)
- 11:10 CS: BrightCart says they had a new pipeline deploy at 10:55 PST
- 11:18 Priya: applied traffic-shape rule -> observing 15% drop in p95 in first 5m

Misc notes to self:
- Save final summary as Confluence page under /incidents/BrightCart-2026-03-13
- Schedule 1:1 with Chao to review kernel selection heuristics later this week
- If rollback needed, request release-window and pair with reliability on call

--- end of scratchpad ---
